messages:
pagerbot: PagerDuty page fired PD-INC-7892 — service=inference-streaming region=eu-west error_rate=5% threshold=1% at 2026-03-15T10:12:25Z

morgan: ack — oncall here, grabbing it.

incident-bot: auto-ack recorded. escalation window 10m before level2. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-latency

jess: thanks. seeing spikes on dashboards — 500s for /v1/generate in eu-west. any customer reports?

morgan: confirmed. spike started ~10:10 UTC, majority 502s from runtime nodes. tagging @sam for runtime investigation.

sam: looking into pod logs now. tail shows repeated OOMs on cuda:2 and high kvcache evictions. canary runtime was promoted ~09:05 — checking correlation.

tara: quick q — is traffic routing to canary only in eu-west?

morgan: yes, policy routed a small percent to canary in eu-west only. rolling it back now. command I'm running: ```kubectl -n inference rollout undo deploy/canary-runtime --to-revision=3```

sam: rollback started, killing hung pods, GC kicking in. watching pod readiness.

alisha: flagging support — AcmeCorp opened a ticket about timeouts. estimate of customer impact?

morgan: preliminary impact: ~3% of requests in eu-west get 502/timeout; some streaming sessions see elevated latency. Not global, confined to eu-west.

jess: can we shift traffic to eu-central while we stabilize? capacity there?

sam: eu-central has ~40% spare headroom. I'll adjust routing. command: ```redwoodctl route set region eu-central weight 80 --service inference-streaming```

incident-bot: reroute executed: eu-central=80% eu-west=20%. Monitoring update channels.

morgan: monitoring error_rate and p50/p95. goal: errors <0.5% and p95 <400ms for 5 continuous minutes to consider resolved.

jess: status check in 5m. @morgan please capture root cause hypothesis once you have logs.

sam: from logs: new memory allocator in canary + kvcache eviction under batch load -> RSS spike and OOMs. hypothesis: allocator+kvcache interaction.

morgan: noted. opening incident ticket INF-2026-83 assigned to runtime-team. mitigation = rollback + reroute. longer-term: revert allocator or tune kvcache thresholds.

alisha: drafting customer-facing note: "We're investigating increased errors in EU-West causing intermittent timeouts for a subset of streaming requests. Mitigations in progress; we'll follow up with status updates."

jess: good. Morg/Sam — ETA to baseline?

morgan: rollback should finish ~2m, reroute <1m, full stabilization ~10m barring surprises.

incident-bot: automatic update (5m elapsed): error_rate eu-west -> 0.8%, global -> 0.4%.

morgan: trend looks positive. continuing to monitor. will post updates.

sam: rollback complete, new pods healthy, memory metrics back near baseline. no more OOMs observed in the last 90s.

alisha: updating support ticket and posting the preliminary note to affected customers.

jess: if stable for 10m let's close and schedule RCA.

morgan: agreed. assigning postmortem owner: sam. next steps: RCA, regression tests on allocator config, add alerting for kvcache eviction rate crossing X.

pagerbot: PD-INC-7892 resolved by morgan at 2026-03-15T10:28:03Z — incident auto-close pending postmortem.

morgan: closing thread for now, will reopen if anything regresses. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
